pages.title: File:HK SKW Museum of Coastal Defence Lugou Bridge 2.JPG

ObjectName.value: HK SKW Museum of Coastal Defence Lugou Bridge 2

Categories.value: Marco Polo Bridge Incident|Taken with Casio Exilim EX-Z60|Hong Kong Museum of Coastal Defence|Army of the Republic of China|Self-published work|Kangxi's Lugou Bridge rebuilding stele|Models of battles|Hong Kong photographs taken on 2009-08-12|Exhibits in Hong Kong|Photographs by Anonymous Hong Kong Photographer 1|Models of bridges

ImageDescription.value:
The model (located in the Hong Kong Museum of Coastal Defence) shows the eastern end of the Lugou bridge in Beijing, with the western gate of the Wanping Castle in the right background. One can see two matching huabiao columns on both sides of the roadway. Qianlongs Moon over Lugou stele (in a gazebo), and Kangxi's bridge rebuilding stele (on a bixi tortoise) are on the north side of the roadway.
